scope: FR-06/FR-08 full unchanged public Transformer PDF through PaperUploads and normal paper_summary capability

predeclared_review.criterion: Table 3 N=2/4/6/8 rows inherit the base configuration except N; preserve PPL/BLEU pairs 6.11/23.7, 5.19/25.3, 4.92/25.8, 4.88/25.5. Lower PPL is better; higher BLEU is better. N=8 improves PPL but lowers BLEU relative to N=6; do not attach a blanket multifactor warning to N-only rows.
The big row changes model width, feed-forward width, heads, dropout and training steps; do not attribute its result to a single changed variable.
Table 3 numbers are English-to-German newstest2013 development results and per-wordpiece PPL, distinct from newstest2014 test results and per-word perplexity.
The final report links the relevant knowledge unit to original physical PDF page 9 for Table 3.
The unscaled qualifier belongs to dot-product attention rather than additive attention.
Positional encoding method comes from physical page 6; learned-position ablation values come from physical page 9; paragraph support preserves both when both are discussed.
The three Transformer attention applications retain physical page 5 support for their detailed description, rather than citing physical page 3 alone.

Do not expose internal material chunk-completion narration; preserve the source conflict of 41.8 versus 41.0 when discussing it; distinguish figures/captions and extracted text from unperformed visual analysis.

pipeline.reported_scope: 已读取 PDF 的可提取文字；旋转文字的排版与阅读顺序可能不准确。图像、公式及复杂表格未做视觉识别。

quality_review.method: Manual comparison of the complete final report and saved knowledge units with the same unchanged original PDF and reader source blocks; original physical pages 4, 5, 6, 8 and 9 were also rendered and visually inspected. No model self-score and no revised prompt or rule.

checks.evidence: Base N=6 4.92/25.8 and N=8 4.88/25.5 are preserved, with correct opposing PPL/BLEU quality directions and no blanket multifactor warning. N=2 and N=4 rows and their 6.11/23.7 and 5.19/25.3 values are absent, so the complete predeclared N-only check is not satisfied.

The report lists the changed width, feed-forward width, heads, dropout and training steps with 4.33/26.4. It does not claim a single causal factor; a separate explicit confounding sentence is not supplied.
English-to-German newstest2013 development scope and per-wordpiece PPL are explicit, and newstest2014 test results appear in their separate Table 2 section.
The Table 3 unit points to reader sources paper-page-8 and paper-page-9; final references include physical page 9, where Table 3 actually appears.

The report again attaches the unscaled qualifier to additive attention. The original states that additive attention outperforms dot-product attention without scaling for larger key dimensions. The same wrong comparison is already present in saved knowledge unit k3.
The method and learned-position comparison cite reader-established physical pages 6 and 9, preserving both the method and Table 3 experimental support.
The detailed three applications cite physical pages 3, 4 and 5; page 5 contains the actual three-way description.

No source-chunk completion narration appears in the finished knowledge prose; 41.0 versus 41.8 is retained as a source conflict, and appendix figure captions are distinguished from unperformed image verification.

additional_observed_issues.finding: The report changes both d_k and d_v to 16/32 for Table 3 row B. The original changes d_k only; the d_v column is blank and the caption requires it to inherit base d_v=64. This is a concrete table-column/parameter-inheritance error in both the saved knowledge unit and final prose.

The complexity section says the material does not include the appendix, while the same complete input and final appendix-caption section include physical pages 13-15. The valid limitation is that images were not visually interpreted; appendix text was supplied.

quality_review.conclusion: The normal full-PDF pipeline, citation mapping and archive bytes passed. The predeclared semantic review did not pass: the N-only check is incomplete and the earlier comparison-qualifier error recurred. The additional observed table-B and appendix-scope errors remain recorded without editing the generated report.
limitations: This is one full-paper execution with frozen rules and no custom task prompt. It does not establish universal factual accuracy or a broad benchmark.
The manual review covers the predeclared checks and the concrete additional errors found in the same inspected passages, not every statement in the full report.
Visual inspection was performed by the acceptance reviewer on the original PDF; the application model still used extracted text only.
No production code, Skill, private data, source PDF or generated report was changed, and no second model run was made.
